title: Tracecat 1.0.0-beta.52-rc.11
body_markdown:
## Breaking changes


- name real vendor parameters on recently shipped providers ([#3289](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3289) )


## Integrations


- add GitHub search and gist actions ([#3285](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3285) )
- add Rippling HRIS integration ([#3286](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3286) )
- add Jamf Pro and Iru MDM integrations ([#3287](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3287) )
- add OSINT and threat intelligence provider templates ([#3288](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3288) )
- repair bracketed pagination inputs and numeric ID filters ([#3291](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3291) )
- support Shared Drives across the Drive integration ([#3295](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3295) )


## Agents


- otel config and deployment plumbing ([#2638](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/2638) )
- otel wiring ([#2650](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/2650) )


## Enhancements


- make version history shell host-configurable ([#3279](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3279) )


## Bug fixes


- harden expression resolution at durable sinks ([#3234](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3234) )
- centralize React Query error handling ([#3271](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3271) )
- persist action environment on create and edit ([#3278](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3278) )
- leave org enrollment to provisioning and invitations ([#3297](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3297) )


## Other


- add title and description versioning ([#3272](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3272) )
- add case version history and restore APIs ([#3282](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3282) )
- expose integration permissions ([#3294](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3294) )


**Full changelog** :[1.0.0-beta.52-rc.10...1.0.0-beta.52-rc.11](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.0.0-beta.52-rc.10...1.0.0-beta.52-rc.11)
